scheme_name: Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU)
overview: Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU) is a Central Sector Scheme administered by NCGTC that provides guarantee coverage for loans up to Rs.10 lakh sanctioned by Banks, NBFCs, MFIs, or other financial intermediaries to eligible micro units. It also covers overdraft loan amounts of Rs.10,000 sanctioned under PMJDY accounts. The scheme aims to facilitate collateral-free credit access for micro enterprises by sharing lending risk with financial institutions.
objectives: Provide guarantee coverage for loans up to Rs.10 lakh to eligible micro units
Cover overdraft loan amounts of Rs.10,000 under PMJDY accounts
Facilitate collateral-free credit access for micro enterprises
Strengthen flow of institutional credit to micro units
Reduce barriers to credit access for underserved sections
eligibility: Eligible micro units seeking loans from Banks / NBFCs / MFIs / other financial intermediaries engaged in providing credit facilities. Overdraft loan amount of Rs.10,000 sanctioned under PMJDY accounts shall also be eligible to be covered under Credit Guarantee Fund.
benefits: Collateral-free loan access for micro units, guarantee coverage reducing lending risk for financial institutions, inclusion of PMJDY overdraft loans up to Rs.10,000, enhanced credit accessibility for underserved micro enterprises.
financial_support: The scheme provides guarantee coverage for loans up to the specified limit of Rs.10 Lakh sanctioned by Banks / NBFCs / MFIs / other financial intermediaries. Further, overdraft loan amount of Rs.10,000 sanctioned under PMJDY accounts is also eligible for coverage under the Credit Guarantee Fund.
application_process: 1. Eligible Lending Institutions (ELIs) must register with NCGTC by submitting a signed and stamped undertaking along with Board Resolution. 2. Upon successful registration, login credentials are created for the ELI on NCGTC’s portal. 3. The ELI can then apply for guarantee cover on loans extended to eligible micro units via the NCGTC portal. 4. Guarantee fee is payable monthly by the 7th day of each month for the outstanding loan amount.
implementing_agency: National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company Ltd (NCGTC)
caveats: Guarantee fee must be paid monthly by the 7th day of each month
Recovery from borrowers requires proportionate sharing with NCGTC after legal cost adjustment
Scheme is administered by NCGTC as a trustee company for the Credit Guarantee Fund
